[[File:Easter egg detail.png|left|100px]]
'''Easter eggs''' are edible [[holiday items]]. Two easter eggs can be obtained by completing one of the [[Easter event|Easter]] [[holiday events]] that occur once per year. This also rewards the player with all other holiday items associated with Easter.

Consuming an easter egg will restore 14 [[hitpoints]], which is the same amount of hitpoints as [[swordfish]] and [[pumpkin]]s. Due to their limited availability and resulting price, easter eggs are not recommended as food.

Previously, they were obtainable during the [[2013 Rare Drops]] event (from [[21 July]] to [[28 July]]) as part of a [[Easter egg (2013 Rare Drops)|rare item drop]].

== Trivia ==
* On release, the Easter egg was reported to heal only 8 hitpoints.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20020806142330/http://runescape.webpunch.net:80/cgi-bin/newspro/viewnews.cgi?newsall webpunch.net "Happy Easter Everyone !!"]</ref> If true however, it was changed very shortly after to match the 14 heal of [[Pumpkin]]s.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20020411181916/http://www.maddogcarter.com:80/runescape/buy.html ''maddogcarter.com "Phil's RuneScape cooking guide"'' April 2002]</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20020609145608/http://www.rune-scape.narod.ru/food.html ''rune-scape.narod.ru "Еда"'' June 2002]</ref>
